headlines.title: Pete Hegseth says impeachment push is a ‘farce’
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Tuesday that the effort to impeach him by an outgoing Republican congressman is nothing but a “political spectacle.”

headlines.title: Republicans, reeling from an election drubbing, will choose their leadership in Congress
headlines.description: Reps. Jim Jordan and Steve Scalise are vying for the top spot in the House, while John Thune is expected to remain Senate Republican leader, despite a conservative push to delay.

headlines.title: Supreme Court clears way for border wall construction in Big Bend area in Texas
headlines.description: The Supreme Court has allowed for construction of the Trump administration's border wall in the remote Big Bend region of Texas that includes a national park. NBC News' Julia Ainsley has details on the decision and the environmental concerns opponents raised in court.

headlines.title: Hegseth says the impeachment push against him is a 'farce' and 'stunt'
headlines.description: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran conflict and other military actions. Hegseth dismissed the effort as “a farce” and “a stunt,” calling Massie a “disgruntled” congressman.

headlines.title: Nvidia Loses $200B in Value Amid Alleged Chinese Spy Scandal
headlines.description: Nvidia, the world’s most valuable chipmaker, is facing major stock market losses and new scrutiny in Washington where the concern for national security and the demand for answers is growing. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: California voters reject new tax on billionaires in a blow to the left
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Proposition 40, which split Democrats in the state and nationally, failed after facing a barrage of attack ads.

headlines.title: Democratic lawmakers seek to restore deportation protections to Afghans in the U.S.
headlines.description: Reps. Jason Crow of Colorado and Sam Liccardo of California plan to file a petition Monday to require a vote on a bill to grant Afghans protection from deportation until mid-2029.

headlines.title: Trump defends Pete Hegseth at surprise news briefing with Dana White
headlines.description: The president said he would stand by the defense secretary if impeached and claimed, “We won the war in Iran,” despite ongoing conflict in the region.

headlines.title: Trump Media cashes in on high-speed access to social media posts
headlines.description: The firm’s revenue jumped more than 200% after it started selling a direct feed of posts from Truth Social, whose most prominent user is President Trump.

headlines.title: Supreme Court paves way for Trump to build a section of his border wall in Big Bend
headlines.description: The Trump administration has faced opposition to its plan to build border security infrastructure in a remote part of Texas that includes Big Bend National Park.

headlines.title: A Capitol Hill vibe shift: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur digs into the vibe shift on Capitol Hill with lawmakers returning to Washington for the first time since the midterm elections.
